subject: Challenge list in the menu
author: ZombieTron
body:
I had to boot up Paradise to check where this is. When you get into the game (offline or online) you can press start to get into the Menus, then press LB or RB til you get to the Paradise City Live menu, the 4th selection down is View Challenges.

When you go into the "View Challenges" menu, you will see tick/check marks next to all of the challenges you have completed and you can scroll up and down through all of the different challenges and scroll left and right through the number of players needed.

Hope this helps, and sorry for the delayed response! 🙂
